description: Complete successful main-tail EC_CODE allocation/reuse, release and verified process-retirement order through the first embree3.dll failure, the client.dll dependency failure and retry, and the later generation rotation. The first client.dll copy succeeds after a three-receipt 48 MiB transfer. The 32 MiB frontier is still live at both image failures and is freed only afterward. Captured addresses identify baseline geometry; replay must release returned handles after counterfactual placement. Historical ordinary FREE receipts are not upgraded to process retirement proof.
line_note: Line numbers count raw LF bytes, matching rg and sed; embedded control characters must not be split into additional lines.
clock_note: seconds preserve integer wall-clock seconds from the most recent bounded xp timestamp, relative to 14:47:14 (matching time(NULL) second boundaries). Before the first xp timestamp, zero is used. clock_lower_bound values are bounds, not exact event timestamps.
head_note: Head follows the largest actual allocation endpoint or explicit fresh-tail, bump or anonymous allocation cursor snapshot so far. Subtract data_align_delta from logged image used to recover the actual allocation endpoint. The high client.dll tail transfer does not advance the bump; both failures report exact head 0x269c8000.

free_extents_at_failure.source: unused suffix of transferred client.dll range

contiguity_note: The qualified retired 16 MiB at RX 0x344ff8000 is separated from ordinary FREE 16 MiB at RX 0x343ff0000 by active 16 KiB dispatchers at RX 0x344ff0000 (steamwebhelper.exe lease 7) and RX 0x344ff4000 (cs2.exe lease 23). The other ordinary FREE 16 MiB at RX 0x346ffc000 belongs to the live CS2 lease and is reused only after both image failures. The new 32 MiB frontier becomes ordinary FREE at line 46682 with age zero and no retirement receipt.
projection_note: Image rows reproduce logged allocation sizes and locations, including reuse below the head and the high client.dll transfer. They do not imply every image advances the bump. The older image free extents have only an aggregate count and bytes here; no individual size or address is attributed to them.
owner_note: owner and lease in snapshots identify the last allocation provenance. Production clears the active peb field when it retires a carve; allocation_lease and matching retired_lease carry the receipt identity. An ordinary FREE before owner retirement retains no retirement receipt.
